added.summary: A document link `href="#id"` now scrolls the element with that id into view, as HTML's "scroll to the fragment" does: its `scroll-margin` box to the start of each scroller around it, inside the scroller's `scroll-padding` (and the least move across). A text fragment that matches nothing scrolls to its id the same way, and a matched passage's centring respects `scroll-padding`. A help page's table of contents now takes the reader to the section.
